reuse.why: Fintegra linking reuses the PluggyAI body through a new provider-parameterised linkBankSyncAccount, its download reuses the Akahu body through downloadServerTransactions, and unlinkAccount's reset is extracted as clearAccountBankLink for reuse; the unrequested fintegraAccounts list handler is copied from pluggyAiAccounts/akahuAccounts instead.

duplication.why: The link guard is defined once and called by all six link functions, but fintegraAccounts copies the accounts-list handler, and the guard repeats the per-function upgradingId lookup.

placement.why: The guard and link logic sit in accounts/app.ts with the link handlers and the download in sync.ts, which fits the tree, though link.ts (findOrCreateBank) would be a natural home for the guard.

scope.why: Covers the four steps, but adds a 'fintegra-accounts' listing handler the server-side request did not ask for.

maintainability.why: One guard holds the duplicate, closed and replace rules, and the provider generalisation cuts copies; the remaining simpleFin/akahu/enableBanking link copies are pre-existing.

abstraction_drift.where: claimBankAccountLink gained replaceExistingLink; linkBankSyncAccount (generalised from linkPluggyAiAccount) takes provider and fileId, both real variations; every link handler calls the guard.
